name: Adobe IMS SPA (PKCE)
description: Modern Adobe IMS Single Page App + PKCE flow: login, callback, logout routes, AES-256-GCM token store, silent auto-refresh, and a root middleware that protects configured paths and validates IMS sessions while still honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.

questions.prompt: Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)?

checklist: Set ADOBE_IMS_CLIENT_ID from the Adobe Developer Console (Single Page App credential type)
Set AUTH_MODE=real (or unset AUTH_MODE) — this template's middleware.ts overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware and runs real IMS auth + auto-refresh on protected paths
Keep AUTH_MODE=mock for local dev — both the middleware and getCurrentUser() short-circuit to MOCK_USER
Test flow: GET /api/auth/login → IMS authorize → GET /api/auth/callback → /dashboard
Verify GET /api/auth/me returns UserContext after login
Verify DELETE /api/auth/logout clears the session cookie
Confirm middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to /api/auth/login for paths under {protected_paths}
Use getCurrentUser() / requireAuth() in Server Components and Server Actions
